name: ʿAbd al-Qāhir al-Jurjānī
summary: Grammarian and theorist of balāgha; his al-ʿAwāmil al-miʾa counts a hundred governors and is the first book of naḥw in many Indian and Ottoman madrasas.
bio: ʿAbd al-Qāhir lived and taught in Jurjān and died in 471/1078. He is best known for his works on the theory of eloquence, but his short book of the hundred governors (ʿawāmil) shaped the teaching of naḥw for centuries.

sources.title: ʿAwāmil al-miʾa with Naḥv-i Mīr, Penn Libraries
